note: The funny gadgets. Each wires a real RDR2 asset to a HITMAN-style effect. Keys are RDR2 control ids used via IS_CONTROL_PRESSED (exact control numbers are constants in the code's controls header, tested in game).

rows.label: Coin (Stamped 1899)
rows.effect: toss coin ahead, it clinks, guards within 25m walk to investigate (guard_ai coin_investigate), 10s then gone
rows.funnyNote: HITMAN's coin. In the frontier it buys nothing and fools everyone.

rows.label: Fiber Wire (Horsehair)
rows.effect: instant silent takedown from behind (kills system), no combat raised
rows.funnyNote: Diana calls it 'the wire'. Arthur calls it 'the rein'.

rows.label: Rubber Duck (Do Not Feed)
rows.effect: thrown dynamite: loud lethal comedy, instantly forfeits Silent Assassin (scoring usedLoudWeapons)
rows.funnyNote: Diana explicitly forbade this duck. Arthur brought three.
